reason: The \(44.9\%\) trade-count bound is supported and non-obvious, but it follows from Q alone; P contributes a general calibration protocol, not a result for this market. With only ten runs per model, its \(95\%\) order statistic has \(k=11>10\), and neither paper supplies a calibrated welfare guarantee or evidence that an intervention improves welfare. A substantive connection needs run-level outcomes and a tested, prespecified intervention.
